svg.aria-label: A PAL C64 frame is 312 lines of 63 cycles. On every eighth line of the text area the VIC-II stops the CPU for about 40 cycles to fetch the character pointers.
svg.title: A PAL C64 frame is 312 lines of 63 cycles. On every eighth line of the text area the VIC-II stops the CPU for about 40 cycles to fetch the character pointers.
svg.text: 312 lines of 63 cycles = 19656 cycles a frame. On a badline the VIC-II takes about 40 of them.
red: badlines, one per text row (25 rows)
Sprites take more cycles on the lines they appear on.
Raster interrupts fire on a chosen line. Games use them
to change colours, split the screen or play music.
A port that runs game logic per frame must give it the
same cycles the real frame left over.
